info.title: Medika Clinical Platform API
info.description:
Multi-Tenant Healthcare SaaS REST API covering:
- **Tenancy & Brand Onboarding (AHC-3):** Automated subdomain provisioning, reserved slug validation, and collision suggestions.
- **Branches & Consultation Rooms (AHC-4):** Multi-branch clinic management, physical consultation rooms, `btree_gist` room reservation locks, and staff RBAC assignments.
- **Provider Services Catalog (AHC-5):** Clinical services pricing catalog, continuous duration slot allocation, and soft deactivation preserving historical records.
- **Provider Availability & Exceptions (AHC-6 & AHC-7):** Recurring weekly working shifts, meal break blocking, cross-branch collision prevention (`422`), planned leave blocking, emergency cancellations (`REQUIRES_RESCHEDULING`), receptionist alerts, and immutable audit logs.
- **Optimistic Slot Hold & Scheduling (AHC-8):** Unauthenticated 300s Redis slot holds (`lock:doctor:{id}:slot:{HHmm}`) with Turnstile verification & IP rate limiting (max 2 active holds/IP), and authenticated double-booking-free confirmation (`POST /api/v1/appointments`).

put.summary: Update an existing clinical service definition

post.summary: Register a new medical brand tenant and provision its exclusive subdomain
post.description: [AHC-3 AC-1 & AC-2] Validates slug format and reserved system words, returns 409 Conflict with 3 suggestions on collision, or provisions the tenant and dispatches an activation email.

post.summary: Place an unauthenticated 300-second optimistic hold on a slot
post.description: [AHC-8 AC-1 & AC-3] Verifies Turnstile anti-bot token and IP rate limits (max 2 active holds per IP), creates Redis lock `lock:doctor:{id}:slot:{HHmm}` mapped to `holdToken` with 300s TTL, and hides the slot from other users.

post.summary: Register a planned leave block for future dates with zero booked appointments
post.description: [AHC-7 AC-1 & AC-3] Immediately suppresses all public and internal slots in the date range and writes an immutable audit log entry.

get.summary: List all configured weekly shift windows for a provider across branches

post.summary: Configure recurring weekly shift windows and meal breaks for a provider at a branch
post.description: [AHC-6 AC-1 & AC-2] Saves weekly shift windows per branch and rejects cross-branch schedule collisions on the same weekday with HTTP 422 Unprocessable Entity.

get.summary: List clinical services for a provider (filterable by activeOnly)

post.summary: Create a clinical service with specialty, duration in minutes, and consultation fee
Trigger an urgent emergency cancellation block with a mandatory reason
post.description: [AHC-7 AC-2 & AC-3] Transitions all affected SCHEDULED appointments to REQUIRES_RESCHEDULING, creates a HIGH-priority receptionist alert, notifies affected patients, and records an immutable audit log.

get.summary: List continuous time-block service appointments for a provider

post.summary: Book a continuous time block based on the clinical service duration

get.summary: List all clinic branches (sedes) for the active brand tenant

post.summary: Register a new clinic branch (sede) with IANA timezone validation

get.summary: List physical consultation rooms (consultorios) for a branch

post.summary: Create a physical consultation room with strict concurrency capacity = 1
Reserve a physical room time slot (enforcing PostgreSQL btree_gist overlap exclusion)

get.summary: List all doctor and receptionist branch assignments for the active tenant

post.summary: Assign a doctor (multi-branch allowed) or receptionist (single-branch bound) to a branch
Confirm an appointment using a valid Bearer JWT and matching holdToken
post.description: [AHC-8 AC-2 & AC-4] Verifies Redis lock ownership, persists the appointment in PostgreSQL as SCHEDULED with btree_gist temporal exclusion, deletes the Redis lock, and returns 201 Created.

patch.summary: Soft-deactivate (INACTIVE) or reactivate (ACTIVE) a clinical service preserving historical records

get.summary: Resolve the active brand tenant from the Host subdomain or X-Tenant-Slug header
get.description: [AHC-3 AC-3] Returns the tenant context resolved by TenantInterceptor.

get.summary: List immutable schedule block and cancellation audit log entries for a provider
Generate real-time bookable slots for a provider on a specific date and branch
get.description: [AHC-6 AC-1, AHC-7 AC-1, AHC-8 AC-1 & AC-3] Exposes bookable slots strictly within shift windows, blocking meal breaks, planned leave ranges, active 300s Redis holds, and confirmed appointments.

get.summary: Retrieve a historical appointment preserving snapshot pricing and service name
List confirmed and rescheduling-pending appointments for a doctor
Get the branch scheduling matrix of assigned doctors and receptionists
List high-priority receptionist dashboard alerts for a branch

bearerAuth.description: Stateless JWT token obtained after login or WhatsApp/Email OTP verification
bearerAuth.name: bearerAuth

tenantSlugHeader.description: Explicit multi-tenant brand slug header (e.g. 'clinica-irma') when not invoking via wildcard subdomain Host
tenantSlugHeader.name: X-Tenant-Slug
